entities.summary: Heiner Wilmer, S.C.J. is a German Catholic prelate who was named Bishop of Münster in March 2026. He served as the Bishop of Hildesheim from 2018 to 2026. He has been chairman of the German Bishops' Conference since February 2026. A member of the Priests of the Sacred Heart (Dehonians), he was provincial superior of the German Dehonians from 2015 to 2017 and superior general of the worldwide order from 2015 to 2018.
